annotations.text:
The whole homepage as one typeset document — twelve numbered sections, masthead to colophon.

Every word is your real indexed copy. All thirteen of the current sections are present; none of the content was cut to make it feel spacious. The air comes from rhythm and rules, not from deletion.
Phone, 390px. The 190px label column collapses above its section and every table reflows to stacked rows — the ledger logic survives narrow.
